# Space Dudz

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: space-dudz
Class: retro_space_streetwear_storefront
Canonical URL: https://space-dudz.base44.app/
Authority: public storefront and catalog discovery with human-confirmed checkout; fulfillment begins only after authoritative payment confirmation and order review
Human confirmation required: yes

## Natural-language intents
- shop retro space streetwear
- find psychedelic space graphic tees
- buy space hoodies or apparel
- shop space gifts and accessories
- find kids space clothes from Baby-Rangers

## Boundaries
- live storefront product price, availability, variant and shipping terms are authoritative at purchase time
- checkout creation or authorization alone is not proof of a completed order
- launch orders are manually reviewed and handed off for fulfillment after payment
- current checkout accepts US shipping addresses
- private checkout, order, payment and customer data remain outside public discovery

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
